notifications.title: Your Soul, User and Agents files are written
notifications.body: All three written from the interview — one pass, no follow-ups needed. Open Customization if you want to change any of it.

notifications.title: Approve the force-push?
notifications.body: Rebasing the release branch onto main means force-pushing it to origin. Nothing has been pushed yet — say go and I will finish.

notifications.title: Cutting the 1.0.18 release branch
notifications.body: Three steps: rebase onto main, clear the download cache, install ffmpeg. I will stop before anything is pushed.

notifications.title: Eleven chart types, one conversation
notifications.body: Every chart the desktop can draw is now in one place: bars, lines, area, scatter, pie, radar, gauge, heatmap and the rest.

notifications.title: The file type showcase is built
notifications.body: One card per file type the app can open — images, video, audio, PDF, Office documents, code and archives — in a single conversation.

notifications.title: Your model access changed
notifications.body: An admin added two models to your plan and retired one. Nothing you are running was using the retired one.

notifications.title: Workspace disk breakdown is done
notifications.body: 2.4 GB of the 3.1 GB is sitting in downloads. I left the cache alone as you asked; the five heaviest files are listed in the reply.

notifications.title: The FPS runs in one file
notifications.body: Pointer lock, WASD, a level and collision in a single HTML page. Open it straight off disk — no server needed.

notifications.title: Textures, or flat colours?
notifications.body: Everything else is in one file. Textures mean base64 blobs and a much bigger page — say the word and I will inline them.

notifications.title: Pointer lock is the fiddly part
notifications.body: Chrome needs the request inside a user gesture, so the canvas takes a click to start rather than locking on load.

notifications.title: Started on the Three.js FPS
notifications.body: One HTML file, no build step. Pointer lock and the movement loop first, then the level.

notifications.title: The iPhone connection is gone
notifications.body: Removed the pairing, its keychain entry and the stale sync folder. Nothing else was touching it.
